verdict.rationale: Elastic's own Cases feature lets teams track investigation details, assign tasks, and collaborate on resolutions, which covers basic incident declaration and tracking. Nothing in the evidence documents on-call schedules or escalation policies; alert routing to third-party incident management systems is an external dependency and earns no credit. Missing for 10: on-call scheduling, escalation policies, incident timelines, documented incident declaration workflow, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies

citations.quote: Cases allows teams to stay aware of potential issues and track investigation details, assign tasks, and collaborate on resolutions.
